answer_1.quote: Lexical Substitution is the task of generating appropriate words which can replace a target word in a given sentence without changing the sentence's meaning.
answer_1.outputs: substitute words for target words in context

answer_2.quote: We use the official metrics that the organizers provided in the original lexical substitution task of SemEval-2007. These were best and best-mode which validate the quality of the model's best prediction and both oot (out-of-ten) and oot-mode to evaluate the coverage of the gold substitute candidate list by the 10-top predictions.

answer_4.quote: The gold standard was based on manual annotation where annotators provided up to 3 possible substitutes.
answer_4.guideline: annotators provided up to 3 possible substitutes
